questions.question: What transitional rites are typically associated with the life cycle of a person?
choices: A: Birthday celebrations, weddings, anniversaries, farewells
B: Travel, sports, nutrition, hobbies
C: Leisure, education, profession, retirement
D: Birth, initiation, marriage, death
questions.explanation: Transitional rites are ritual actions that mark important life phases. They can vary culturally but often involve transitions from childhood to adulthood, from youth to marriage, and finally death as the last transition in the life cycle.

What function do neurons serve in the nervous system?
Neurons are the basic building blocks of the nervous system and are responsible for transmitting electrical signals. These signals enable communication between the brain and the rest of the body.
